apis.name: USDA FoodData Central
apis.why_notable: Official US government nutrition database with branded and foundation foods; free API key.

apis.name: Open Food Facts
apis.why_notable: Crowdsourced global product nutrition/barcode database; free REST API, no key for read.

apis.name: Nutritionix
apis.why_notable: Natural-language food logging and restaurant nutrition data widely used in fitness apps.

apis.name: Edamam Nutrition Analysis
apis.why_notable: Recipe and nutrition analysis API with food database and diet labels.

apis.name: Spoonacular
apis.why_notable: Recipe search, meal planning, and ingredient nutrition with large food knowledge graph.

apis.name: ExerciseDB
apis.why_notable: Exercise library with GIF demos, body-part and equipment filters; popular via RapidAPI.

apis.name: API Ninjas Exercises
apis.why_notable: Simple exercise search by muscle, type, and difficulty; free tier with API key.

apis.name: Wger Workout Manager
apis.why_notable: Open-source workout/exercise REST API with exercises, workouts, and nutrition endpoints.

apis.name: OpenFDA
apis.why_notable: FDA public data: drugs, devices, food recalls, adverse events; free no-key for light use.

apis.name: RxNorm
apis.why_notable: NLM drug nomenclature API for drug names, ingredients, and relationships.

apis.name: DailyMed
apis.why_notable: NLM structured product labeling (SPL) for US drug package inserts and labels.

apis.name: MedlinePlus Connect
apis.why_notable: Patient-friendly health topic and drug info linked from codes (ICD, RxNorm, LOINC).

apis.name: NIH ClinicalTrials.gov API
apis.why_notable: Official registry of clinical studies worldwide; modern v2 API is free and public.

apis.name: Disease.sh
apis.why_notable: COVID-19 and vaccine statistics API built on public data sources; free, no key.

apis.name: CDC WONDER
apis.why_notable: CDC epidemiology datasets (mortality, natality, etc.) via API/query interface.

apis.name: WHO GHO OData
apis.why_notable: World Health Organization Global Health Observatory indicators via OData.

apis.name: NPI Registry
apis.why_notable: CMS National Provider Identifier lookup for US healthcare providers and organizations.
